text: At dawn on the fourth day, Gus walked down to the quay and put the lamp key in Dunn’s hand.
Dunn did not take it. He had read the logbook too.
Keep it. Whatever is under this island wants the keeper, not the key.
So Gus went home, fed the cat, trimmed his lantern, and waited for dark.
Because tonight he was going down the tunnel. All the way.
